query: SELECT id AS "id!: String", json_quote(json_extract(payload, '$.record.ended')) AS "ended!: String" FROM record_identities WHERE kind = 'roleAssignment' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.holder.actor.identity.kind') = 'session' AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.holder.actor.identity.session.endpoint.serviceId') = ? AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.holder.actor.identity.session.endpoint.endpointId') = ? AND json_extract(payload, '$.record.holder.actor.identity.session.sessionId') = ? ORDER BY id
